findings.highlight: That's how I've always lived my life.
findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮士郎はそういう生き方を選んだ筈だし
findings.governingReading: He tells himself that Shirou Emiya was supposed to have chosen a way of living in which he cannot abandon someone who is down.
findings.explanation: Shirou's chosen way of life becomes how he has always lived.

findings.highlight: She's going to regenerate, so take her out now.
findings.evidenceJa: そいつ、再生するから一撃で仕留めなさい
findings.governingReading: Illya orders a single killing strike because Saber regenerates.
findings.explanation: The English replaces a one-strike requirement with urgency. This changes the tactical instruction without removing Illya's intent to kill Saber.

findings.highlight: There's a gaping, ragged hole in the middle of my body.
findings.evidenceJa: 胸から下の自分の身体が、ない
findings.governingReading: Shirou initially perceives his body below the chest as absent; the next page describes a large part of his abdomen being taken away.
findings.explanation: The first impression that his body below the chest is gone becomes a central hole. This changes the disoriented perception, without proving a different literal injury.

findings.highlight: There's only a little blood considering how big the wound is. I see some withered, branch-looking things and some shattered...stuff
findings.evidenceJa: 傷のわりには少ない体液とか柔らかそうなあれとか乾いた枝みたいに細かく折れたコレ
findings.governingReading: Shirou sees relatively little bodily fluid, a soft-looking thing, and something finely broken like dry twigs, all kept deliberately vague by deictic words.
findings.explanation: Body fluid becomes blood, and branchlike shattered matter is redistributed into withered branches plus separate shattered stuff.

findings.highlight: I could never have pushed Saber away, so I was just her shield.
findings.evidenceJa: 突き飛ばすのは無理だから、そのまま盾になってみたのか
findings.governingReading: Only after falling and inspecting the damage does he infer that, unable to push her away in time, he apparently put himself in the way.
findings.explanation: Shirou's belated, questioning realization that he tried becoming Saber's shield becomes a settled statement that he was her shield.

findings.evidenceJa: 今度ばかりは取り返しがつかない
findings.governingReading: As his consciousness cuts out, he believes this time the situation cannot be undone.
findings.explanation: Shirou's conclusion that the damage is irreparable becomes the factual statement that he is dead.
